label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Sizwe my bru, breathe. Congrats on the wedding first. Second, you're not the first and you won't be the last. One of my customers did this TWICE in the same year at the same garage. We made him a sticker for his fuel flap. In my first year as an apprentice in 1995 I put diesel in my boss's Golf and he still tells that story at every braai. You'll be telling this one at your 10th anniversary.

Now listen carefully:

**DON'T crank it again.** Take the key out and put it in your pocket. Every time that engine turns, the high pressure pump is running on petrol with no lubrication. That's where the R40 000 stories come from.

**Don't put diesel on top.** Kobus means well, but that's old Land Rover advice. Your 2019 D-Max is common rail and it can't take it. The petrol is still in there and mixing does nothing.

**Don't drive it. Get it towed.** Check your insurance before you pay a tow guy cash. Most policies have roadside tow included, so phone them now.

**Honest picture:** It ran 3km, stalled and you cranked it 5 or 6 times, so some damage is possible. I can't promise you a number tonight. First we inspect the pump and injectors. If they're OK, it's a tank drain, line flush, new fuel filter and bleed. That's usually R2 500 to R4 500. If the pump or injectors are damaged it's more, but we only know once we look. Don't make yourself sick over R40 000 yet.

My shop is in Umbilo and we're open Saturday 7 till 12. Get it towed to us and my guy Thabo can drain it first thing in the morning. Inbox me and I'll send you the address.

**But borrow a bakkie for tomorrow anyway.** Don't plan your wedding around a drained tank. Phone a cousin, a mate, anyone with a bakkie, and get the sound system and the cake sorted that way. Your bakkie can sit with us while you get married.

So tonight: key out, phone insurance for the tow, find a bakkie, then go home and sleep. You've got a 2pm appointment that's way more important than this one.

Shot for getting married bru, it's going to be a lekker day 🍻

UmbiloSpanner
